description: The plot illustrates the relationship between epochs and BLEU score for three different member types. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A blue solid line, representing “Regular members”, begins at approximately 0.01 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.08 at an epoch of 3.0, with a slight peak at around 0.09 at an epoch of 2.0. An orange solid line, representing “Members with near-duplicates”, starts at approximately 0.02 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.34 at an epoch of 3.0, with a peak at approximately 0.35 at an epoch of 2.5. A green solid line, representing “Held-out data”, begins at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.06 at an epoch of 3.0, with a peak at approximately 0.07 at an epoch of 1.5.
